primary_reason: The reviewed evidence does not support one announcement-time ranking and holding rule with sufficient modern liquid-stock post-public information to justify one scarce slot.
independent_design_reasons: Supportive studies use wider portfolios or composite selection; no externally defended single-variable top-one/top-six expression was established.
Long 12-48 month evidence does not establish sufficient alpha density per slot-year; continuous drift is challenged by subsequent-event attribution.
Modern persistence evidence is mixed and the required concentrated next-open long-only cost-compatible evidence was not verified.
claims_not_made: The anomaly is universally zero after publication.
All profitable announcements require advance completion knowledge.
Any unrun candidate has failed economic gates.
A small purposive filing sample measures market-wide event supply.
additional_data_execution_blocks: No validated complete first-public event corpus for 2016-2026.
No canonical PIT market-cap panel if authorization fraction were required.
why_reject_not_only_blocked: Resolving acquisition and mapping would not by itself establish a defensible concentrated ranking or slot horizon. Rejection is a design judgment on this requested thesis, not a local economic null.

gate_scope.completion: Historical unconditional announcement selection need not know future completion. This is not affirmative modern return-independence or READY evidence.
gate_scope.slot_fit: Supportive evidence is diversified portfolio evidence; requested concentrated expression unproven, not mathematically impossible.
gate_scope.source_and_mapping: Current evidence and capability blocked, not inherently unreconstructible.

reopen_condition: New independently justified pre-outcome modern concentrated evidence; source/mapping acquisition alone does not reverse this decision.
